# title: Cash the business made: # caption: Both bars are the same single quarter. Alphabet's operations produced $39.1bn of cash
and cash it spent building: and the company spent $44.9bn building data centres - about $5.9bn more than it earned
column3: which is why free cash flow was negative for the first time in its history as a public company. Capital expenditure doubled against the same quarter a year earlier. I read that gap as buying scarce capacity at the moment it is scarcest
column4: and the rest of this page is my reason for thinking so. It is also the number that would tell me first if I am wrong.
